hero.subtitle: The governed command surface for enterprise AI. Unify software, AI agents, and enterprise platforms into one orchestrated layer where every action is authorized, logged, and reversible.

governance.label: Total Command
governance.description: You issue the directive. OmniHub orchestrates every connected system with full real-time visibility. Actions logged. Agents tracked. Outcomes traceable.

naturalLanguage.title: Natural language directives
naturalLanguage.desc: Issue commands in plain language. OmniHub translates intent into structured task plans dispatched across your agent network.

capabilityRouting.title: Capability-matched routing
capabilityRouting.desc: Each task routes to the most qualified agent. No guesswork, no misroutes, full audit of each routing decision.

override.title: Override any agent, instantly
override.desc: One command halts, redirects, or replaces any running agent mid-execution. You remain in full control at all times.

reversible.label: Architectural Primitive
reversible.description: The only enterprise AI platform where rollback is a first-class architectural primitive. One bad decision does not cascade. You undo it. Completely.

rollback.title: One-click rollback
rollback.desc: Reverse any agent action or workflow state with a single command. No cleanup required.

blastRadius.title: Blast radius containment
blastRadius.desc: OmniHub detects propagation risk and contains failures before they cascade across connected systems.

compensating.title: Compensating transactions
compensating.desc: Each agent action carries a compensating operation. Distributed state stays coherent under rollback across connected systems.

policyRules.name: Scope Restriction
policyRules.desc: No agent accesses unauthorized data scopes

policyRules.name: MAN Mode
policyRules.desc: High-risk actions require Manual Approval Node approval

policyRules.name: Cross-Border Block
policyRules.desc: EU data stays within EEA zones (data residency)

capabilities.label: Platform Capabilities
capabilities.description: One platform. No black boxes. No vendor lock-in. No surprises.

items.title: Universal Connector Network
items.desc: Universal compatibility across legacy, Web2, Web3, AI, NFT, and blockchain applications.

items.title: Tri-Force Architecture
items.desc: A decentralized tripartite model for uncompromised security: Guardian, Planner, and Executor.

items.title: OmniSkills
items.desc: Forge, install, and govern expert-level OmniSkills.

items.title: Real-Time Telemetry
items.desc: Live operational intelligence across all agents and workflows.

items.title: Policy Enforcement Engine
items.desc: Governance rules apply before any action executes.

items.title: PhysiOmni
items.desc: The physical AI operations layer for robotic systems.

items.title: MAN Mode
items.desc: Manual Approval Node. High-risk actions pause at an approval checkpoint.

items.title: Connect AI / BYOM
items.desc: Bring Your Own Model. Plug in any LLM into governed workflows.

maestro.label: Core Philosophy
maestro.description1: Intelligence is not just capability. It is coordination with consequence.
maestro.description2: Enterprise AI must serve your organization's intent. MAESTRO ensures authority scales with the system.

enterprise.label: Enterprise Ready
enterprise.description: Designed from day one for compliance and governance.
